messages:
katie: Quick tabletop at 10 to triage GA readiness for Adaptive Batching v1 — need a hard call on SLA floor, docs cut, oncall coverage, monitoring gates, and pricing promo. Can folks make it?

maria: I can. My priority is locking SLO definitions and an error-budget policy before GA. Prefer conservative start.

aj: From runtime perspective we can reliably hit p95 <= 300ms for typical short sequences on Dedicated. Long sequences and embeddings will vary — propose slice-based SLAs (short/long/embedding).

thomas: Support note: runbooks are non-negotiable. Need playbook for timeout/fallback, how to toggle quantization profiles, and clear escalation path for model-regression reports.

katie: Draft GA minimums I want us to consider: 
- SLA: p95 latency per slice (short) <= 300ms; availability 99.9% for Hosted/Dedicated.
- Docs: runbook + API migration notes + customer FAQ.
- Monitoring: alert if error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m, or p95 latency breach > 2 consecutive 15m windows.
- Pricing: publish burst tiers + reserved commit tiers and an early-adopter promo.
(These are starting points for discussion, not final yet.)

aj: Operationally: burst policy = 2x reserved throughput by default with documented throttling back to committed capacity. We must also document per-model memory/seq limits that trigger 429s.

maria: If we ship 99.9% SLA we must also ship: fallback to model-variant on overload, explicit maintenance windows, and an exceptions list (DDOS, region-level infra failure). Otherwise customers will expect unavailable refunds.

sam: CS ask: we need a customer-facing SLA FAQ that explains credit triggers and timelines. Can someone own drafting that? We should have a short Q/A doc for sales.

thomas: Oncall plan: 30-day intensified burn-in post-GA with primary oncall owned by product-SRE and infra backup. I'll own the runbook edits and playbook docs. Need SLO owner for the math.

katie: Proposed decision (tabletop): ship GA with the SLA floor above, but with a 30-day burn-in clause where SLAs are monitored and may be amended if we hit unexpected workload shifts. Exceptions list to be published. Owners assigned.

katie: Action items (agreed):
```
1) SLO math & exception list — owner: maria — due: Thu EOD
2) Runbook & oncall playbook — owner: thomas — due: Fri EOD
3) Quota/burst docs + throttling behavior — owner: aj — due: Fri EOD
4) Customer-facing SLA FAQ + refund timeline — owner: sam — due: Fri EOD
5) Monitoring alerts & dashboards (p95, error rate, OOMs) — owner: aj — due: Fri EOD
6) Lock GA criteria in release checklist if no objections — owner: katie — due: next Wed noon
```

ops-bot: Reminder: tabletop calendar invite created for 10:00 — link in thread. :bell: 

maria: I'll open the PR for SLO calculations and the exceptions draft this afternoon.

katie: Great. If no major objections by EOD Thursday we'll lock these as the GA acceptance criteria. Thanks everyone — small, focused ship with clear burn-in and owners seems safest. :white_check_mark:
